description: This PHP source file defines a data access object (DAO) class EmploymentContractDao for managing employment contract entities within the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods to retrieve and save employment contract records from/to the database.

classes.name: EmploymentContractDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class providing methods to fetch and save employment contract entities related to employees.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employment contract associated with a given employee number.

methods.name: saveEmploymentContract
methods.description: Persists a new or updated employment contract entity into the database.
